# 1. The relationship between tcc and lst 2013-2021
```{r}
# plot scatter
library(raster)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
source("script/plot_scatter_lst_tcc.R")


# year 2015
rs_tcc <- raster(stringr::str_c("data/raw/NY/nlcd_tcc/clipped/nlcd_tcc_NY_2015.tif"))
rs_lst <- raster(stringr::str_c("data/raw/NY/LST_L8/year_mean/2015.tif")) %>%
  projectRaster(., rs_tcc, method = "ngb")



output_dir <- stringr::str_c("result/orig_scatter/tcc_lst_2015.jpg")

scatters_tcc_lst(tree= rs_tcc, lst = rs_lst,
                 xlabel = expression(bold(paste('Tree Canopy Cover / %', sep = ''))),
                 ylabel = expression(bold(paste('Land Surface Temp / °C', sep = ''))), 
                 output_file = output_dir)
  
```

# 2. read in campaigns data for NYC, other variable, save dataset
```{r}
# Upper 2021-07-24
nyc_boundary <- sf::read_sf('~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/boundary/nybb_dissolved.shp')
nyc_boundary <- st_transform(nyc_boundary, crs = 4326)

Upper_point_af <- sf::read_sf('~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/Heat_Map_Camp/bronx-man/af_trav.shp') %>%
  mutate(datetime = as.POSIXct(datetime, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
upper_ndvi <- read_stars("C:/Users/Jiali/Downloads/upper_nyc_20210724.tif")
upper_af_ndvi <- terra::extract(upper_ndvi, Upper_point_af)
Upper_point_af <- cbind(Upper_point_af, setNames(list(upper_af_ndvi[,2]), "ndvi"))%>%
  mutate(temp_c = (temp_f - 32) * 5 / 9)

# Lower Brooklyn 2022-07-30
Lower_point_af <- sf::read_sf('~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/Heat_Map_Camp/brooklyn/af_trav.shp') %>%
  mutate(datetime = as.POSIXct("2022-07-20 15:30:00", format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")) %>%
  mutate(trav_id = "af")
lower_ndvi <- read_stars("C:/Users/Jiali/Downloads/lower_nyc_20210730.tif")
lower_af_ndvi <- terra::extract(lower_ndvi, Lower_point_af)
Lower_point_af <- cbind(Lower_point_af, setNames(list(lower_af_ndvi[,2]), "ndvi"))%>%
  mutate(temp_c = (temp_f - 32) * 5 / 9)

# set the buffer, compute the surrounding ndvi_avg
window_size <- 51
focal_ndvi <- focal(upper_ndvi, w = matrix(1, window_size, window_size), fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
ndvi_means <- terra::extract(focal_ndvi, Upper_point_af)
Upper_point_af <- cbind(Upper_point_af, setNames(list(ndvi_means[,2]), paste0("ndvi_", window_size)))
focal_ndvi <- focal(lower_ndvi, w = matrix(1, window_size, window_size), fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
ndvi_means <- terra::extract(focal_ndvi, Lower_point_af)
Lower_point_af <- cbind(Lower_point_af, setNames(list(ndvi_means[,2]), paste0("ndvi_", window_size)))


# macro-climate
# for upper 2021-07-24

# daily extreme
up_daily_tmax <- terra::rast("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/Daymet/tmax_daily_2021_ncss.nc")
nycboun_reproj <- sf::st_transform(nyc_boundary, crs = sf::st_crs(terra::crs(up_daily_tmax,proj = T)))
up_daily_tmax <- terra::project(terra::mask (terra::crop(up_daily_tmax, terra::ext(nycboun_reproj)),
                                    nycboun_reproj), terra::crs(nyc_boundary))
up_daily_tmax_sp <- up_daily_tmax[[yday("2021-07-24")]]
writeRaster(up_daily_tmax_sp, filename = "data/proc/daymet/nyc/tmax_daily_upper.tif")


# summer average
tmax.nc <- terra::rast("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/Daymet/tmax_monavg_2021_ncss.nc")
tmin.nc <- terra::rast("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/Daymet/tmin_monavg_2021_ncss.nc")
nycboun_reproj <- sf::st_transform(nyc_boundary, crs = sf::st_crs(terra::crs(tmax.nc,proj = T)))
tmax <- terra::project(terra::mask (terra::crop(tmax.nc, terra::ext(nycboun_reproj)),
                                    nycboun_reproj), terra::crs(nyc_boundary))
tmin <- terra::project(terra::mask (terra::crop(tmin.nc, terra::ext(nycboun_reproj)), 
                                    nycboun_reproj), terra::crs(nyc_boundary))
tmax_summer <- (tmax[[6]]+tmax[[7]]+tmax[[8]])/3
tmin_summer <- (tmin[[6]]+tmin[[7]]+tmin[[8]])/3
tavg_summer <- (tmax_summer + tmin_summer)/2
writeRaster(tavg_summer, filename = "data/proc/daymet/nyc/tavg_summer_upper.tif")

# for lower 2022-07-30
# daily extreme
low_daily_tmax <- terra::rast("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/Daymet/tmax_daily_2022_ncss.nc")
nycboun_reproj <- sf::st_transform(nyc_boundary, crs = sf::st_crs(terra::crs(low_daily_tmax,proj = T)))
low_daily_tmax <- terra::project(terra::mask (terra::crop(low_daily_tmax, terra::ext(nycboun_reproj)),
                                    nycboun_reproj), terra::crs(nyc_boundary))
low_daily_tmax_sp <- low_daily_tmax[[yday("2022-07-30")]]
writeRaster(low_daily_tmax_sp, filename = "data/proc/daymet/nyc/tmax_daily_lower.tif")

# summer average
tmax.nc <- terra::rast("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/Daymet/tmax_monavg_2022_ncss.nc")
tmin.nc <- terra::rast("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/Daymet/tmin_monavg_2022_ncss.nc")
nycboun_reproj <- sf::st_transform(nyc_boundary, crs = sf::st_crs(terra::crs(tmax.nc,proj = T)))
tmax <- terra::project(terra::mask (terra::crop(tmax.nc, terra::ext(nycboun_reproj)),
                                    nycboun_reproj), terra::crs(nyc_boundary))
tmin <- terra::project(terra::mask (terra::crop(tmin.nc, terra::ext(nycboun_reproj)), 
                                    nycboun_reproj), terra::crs(nyc_boundary))
tmax_summer <- (tmax[[6]]+tmax[[7]]+tmax[[8]])/3
tmin_summer <- (tmin[[6]]+tmin[[7]]+tmin[[8]])/3
tavg_summer <- (tmax_summer + tmin_summer)/2
writeRaster(tavg_summer, filename = "data/proc/daymet/nyc/tavg_summer_lower.tif")


# add to sf
up_daily_macro<- terra::rast("data/proc/daymet/nyc/tmax_daily_upper.tif") %>%
  terra::extract(Upper_point_af)
Upper_point_af <- cbind(Upper_point_af, setNames(list(up_daily_macro[,2]), "daymet_tmax_daily"))

up_summer_macro <- terra::rast("data/proc/daymet/nyc/tavg_summer_upper.tif") %>%
  terra::extract(Upper_point_af)
Upper_point_af <- cbind(Upper_point_af, setNames(list(up_summer_macro[,2]), "daymet_tavg_summer"))

low_daily_macro <- terra::rast("data/proc/daymet/nyc/tmax_daily_lower.tif") %>%
  terra::extract(Lower_point_af)
Lower_point_af <- cbind(Lower_point_af, setNames(list(low_daily_macro[,2]), "daymet_tmax_daily"))

low_summer_macro <- terra::rast("data/proc/daymet/nyc/tavg_summer_lower.tif") %>%
  terra::extract(Lower_point_af)
Lower_point_af <- cbind(Lower_point_af, setNames(list(low_summer_macro[,2]), "daymet_tavg_summer"))


# extract the NCLD-2021
# 21-24 developed, open, low - high density
# 41 deciduous forest, 42, evergreen
# 52 shrub
# 71 grass
# 81 pasture

up_ncld <- terra::rast("data/raw/NY/nlcd_tcc/clipped/ncld_nyc_2021.tif") %>%
  terra::extract(Upper_point_af)
Upper_point_af <- cbind(Upper_point_af, setNames(list(as.factor(up_ncld[,2])), "lc_ncld"))

low_ncld <- terra::rast("data/raw/NY/nlcd_tcc/clipped/ncld_nyc_2021.tif") %>%
  terra::extract(Lower_point_af)
Lower_point_af <- cbind(Lower_point_af, setNames(list(as.factor(low_ncld[,2])), "lc_ncld"))

Upper_point_af <- Upper_point_af %>%  mutate(location = "upper")
Lower_point_af <- Lower_point_af %>%  mutate(location = "lower")

# different macro-climate? can not add them up (extract daily)
all_nyc <- bind_rows(Upper_point_af, Lower_point_af) %>%
  dplyr::select("datetime", "temp_c", "rh", "hi_f", "trav_id", "ndvi", "ndvi_11", "ndvi_31", "ndvi_51", "daymet_tmax_daily", "daymet_tavg_summer", "lc_ncld", "location")
saveRDS(all_nyc, file="data/proc/nyc/all_variables.rds")
```


# 3. Some visualization
```{r}
# histogram
plot <- ggplot(all_nyc, aes(x = unlist(temp_c), fill = location)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#00B2EE","#EE9572"), labels = c("Brooklyn & Lower Manhattan", "Bronx & Manhattan")) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
    labs(title = "Temperature at NYC mobile transect points", 
         x = "Temperature (°C)", y = "Density") +
    theme_minimal()

# location
ncld <- read_stars("C:/Users/Jiali/Downloads/ncld_nyc_2021.tif")
plot <- ggplot() +
  #geom_stars(data = lower_ndvi) +
  geom_sf(data = all_nyc, size = 0.1, aes(color = daymet_tavg_summer)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "yellow", high = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(title = "Temperature at NYC mobile transect points", x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 14), 
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 24),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA))


# relationship for temp~lc
nlcd_colors <- c(
  "11" = "#476ba1", # Open Water
  "12" = "#d1def8", # Perennial Ice/Snow
  "21" = "#decaca", # Developed, Open Space
  "22" = "#d99482", # Developed, Low Intensity
  "23" = "#ee0000", # Developed, Medium Intensity
  "24" = "#ab0000", # Developed, High Intensity
  "31" = "#b3aea3", # Barren Land (Rock/Sand/Clay)
  "41" = "#68ab5f", # Deciduous Forest
  "42" = "#1c6330", # Evergreen Forest
  "43" = "#b5ca8f", # Mixed Forest
  "51" = "#a68c30", # Dwarf Scrub*
  "52" = "#ccba7d", # Shrub/Scrub
  "71" = "#e2e2c4", # Grassland/Herbaceous
  "72" = "#c9d6ad", # Sedge/Herbaceous*
  "73" = "#99c147", # Lichens*
  "74" = "#80ba9e", # Moss*
  "81" = "#dbd83d", # Pasture/Hay
  "82" = "#ab7028", # Cultivated Crops
  "90" = "#bad8ea", # Woody Wetlands
  "95" = "#70a3ba"  # Emergent Herbaceous Wetlands
)
filtered_data <- all_nyc %>% filter(lc_ncld != 0)
plot <- ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = factor(lc_ncld), y = daymet_tavg_summer, fill = factor(lc_ncld))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = nlcd_colors) +
  labs(x = "Land Cover (lc_ncld)", y = "Temperature (°C)", title = "Daymet Summer Tavg by Land Cover") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")  # Optionally remove legend if not needed
ggplot(filtered_data, aes(sample = temp_c)) +
  stat_qq() +
  stat_qq_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ lc_ncld)
# Shapiro-Wilk
shapiro_results <- filtered_data %>%
  group_by(lc_ncld) %>%
  summarise(p_value = shapiro.test(temp_c)$p.value)

print(shapiro_results)


# relationship for temp~ndvi 
plot <- ggplot(Upper_point_af, aes(x = ndvi, y = ndvi_31)) +
  #geom_point(color = rgb(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1), size = 0.5) +
  geom_hex(bins = 60, color = NA) +  
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "NDVI_local", y = "Temperature", fill = "Point Count") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 20), axis.title = element_text(size = 22)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty(Upper_point_af$ndvi)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty(Upper_point_af$ndvi_31)) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 22),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18)
  ) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue", formula = y~x) +
  stat_poly_eq(aes(label = paste(after_stat(eq.label), after_stat(rr.label), 
                                 after_stat(p.value.label), sep = "~~~~")),
               formula = y ~ x,
               parse = TRUE,
               label.x = "right", label.y = 0.9,
               size = 6, color = "blue")
```
